items.question: What does Karima Christmas-Kelly do for the Indiana Fever?
items.answer: Karima Christmas-Kelly is an assistant coach for the Indiana Fever. She joined the staff in 2023 and stayed on under head coach Stephanie White. As a player she won the 2012 WNBA title with the Fever.
